import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day = "2026-10-30"
paths = [
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl",
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl",
]
for p in paths:
  print("===", p, "exists=", os.path.exists(p))
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    continue
  n=0
  with open(p, "r", errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
      if day not in line:
        continue
      try:
        o=json.loads(line)
      except Exception:
        continue
      # try extract time/source/text
      ts = o.get("ts") or o.get("time") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("received_at") or ""
      src = o.get("source") or o.get("from") or o.get("kind") or ""
      text = o.get("text") or o.get("summary") or o.get("prompt") or o.get("body") or ""
      if isinstance(text, dict):
        text = str(text)[:200]
      text = (text or "").replace("\n"," ")[:180]
      bus = o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or o.get("reply_to_bus_id") or ""
      if day in str(ts) or day in line[:80] or True:
        # filter more carefully by date fields
        blob = json.dumps(o, ensure_ascii=False)
        if day not in blob and day not in str(ts):
          continue
        print(f"- ts={ts} src={src} bus={bus} | {text}")
        n+=1
        if n>=40: break
  print(f"(shown {n})")
PY
